metaTitle: Custom Direct to Film Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to film shirts for vibrant, durable prints. Perfect for bulk orders. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Direct to film printing produces vibrant, detailed designs on custom shirts without the heavy feel of screen printing. DTF transfers work well on polyester blends and dark fabrics, making them a strong choice for corporate uniforms, event giveaways, or team apparel where color accuracy and soft hand feel matter. The decoration method also supports small runs without setup fees, so you can order exactly what you need for your next campaign.
heroAltText: Custom direct to film shirts with vibrant full-color designs on dark fabric, perfect for bulk corporate orders.
